summary: An NFO future, Quote then Depth on the same client: 5paisa streams no OI on MarketFeedV3, so oi is left out (an OI-only frame makes nothing); adding Depth subscribes MarketDepthService alone, the book carries the latest quote, a new quote frame still reaches the Quote subscription, and dropping Depth unsubscribes only the book.

notes: Frames worked here in 5paisa's MarketFeedV3 and MarketDepthService shapes. The OI-only frame stands for any frame with neither LastRate nor Details: both sides publish nothing from it (_on_data target_modes ()). Its field names are illustrative; neither side subscribes 5paisa's OI method.
